photos.title: Drops of passion
photos.description: Can you see miracles directly? I can't, that is why if I want to capture the presence of a miracle I have to treat it as a reason, not as a fact. This essay is another attempt to the the miracle in the reflection of light. A woman covered with oil and droplets of water is a mirror for this essay. Now if you set your attention free and let your eyes follow what they want - you can feel some kind of excitement, don't you?
